title: Acrobatics
text:
Acrobatics is a keystone passive skill that allows all types of hits to be evaded, at the cost of greatly reducing the user's evasion rating.


== Mechanics ==
This keystone allows players to evade area of effect skills as well as strike or projectile skills. The 75% less Evasion Rating modifier applies multiplicative with other sources of evasion reduction, such as ...and Protect me from Harm.


== Location ==
Acrobatics is located on the right side of the passive skill tree.
